purpose: Universal header at the top of all screens. Offers global functions (search, notifications, user profile, Joule AI) and product-specific elements. Required on every SAP Fiori screen per UXC-016.
whenToUse: As the topmost element of every SAP Fiori application
To provide consistent product identity and global navigation
When users need persistent access to search, notifications, and account
To house the hamburger menu trigger for the SideNavigation
whenNotToUse: For embedded UI inside another application
Avoid a Back button in the shell bar — use the browser Back button instead; only add it if browser Back is unavailable for technical reasons
doRules: Place ShellBar as the first node in screen hierarchy (mandatory on every screen)
SAP logo (mandatory) + product identifier (mandatory) form the branding element — selecting it navigates to the product home page
Help button (mandatory) and Profile button (mandatory) must always be present
Only add actions to the shell bar if users need them frequently — don't replicate shell bar actions in user menu or side navigation
Use color scheme 7 (set 2) tag for trial systems; color scheme 10 (set 2) for multiple productive systems
Recommend expanding the search field by default
Show only the Back button if back navigation is possible — hide it on initial launch or when deep linking
dontRules: Do not place ShellBar inside another container with padding
Do not add custom buttons outside the supported slots
Do not change ShellBar background color — it is locked to sapShellColor
Do not duplicate ShellBar across nested views

layoutGuidance.placement: Topmost element, full viewport width, fixed position.
layoutGuidance.alignment: Branding left, navigation center, actions+avatar right.

contentGuidance.labelLength: Brand text ≤ 2 lines. Avatar shows initials or photo.
contentRules: Use the SAP logo only when authorized

responsiveBehavior.XL: All elements visible, search field expanded.
responsiveBehavior.L: Search field collapsed, all other elements still visible.
responsiveBehavior.M: Additional shell actions move to overflow menu. Lowest-priority context area elements hidden.
responsiveBehavior.S: Product identifier hidden. Only top-priority context area element remains. User menu and product switch stay in place.

accessibilityGuidance.requirement: Brand text contrast ≥ 4.5:1 against shell background
All shell icon buttons MUST have tooltips
Tab order: hamburger → brand → middle → right → avatar
Visible focus indicator on every interactive shell element
Notification badge state announced via aria-live

exceptions: Hamburger variant=False when SideNavigation is permanently visible
Joule (AI Copilot) launches SAP AI assistant — available only when AI features enabled
Badge overflow: single action with badge in overflow shows counter on overflow button; multiple badges show attention indicator only
Additional context area elements don't auto-overflow — listen for hide events to show minified version
